message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. Facts: Defendant Wang's wife made a statement at police station. Wang and his wife went to police station, tore up the statement, tried to leave. Police tried to stop, Wang refused, resisted, causing injury to police officer (high rib fracture, skin abrasions). The injury is light injury. So the crime is assault on police officer, i.e., "妨害公务" (obstructing public duties). Also possibly "故意伤害" (intentional injury) but the victim is a police officer; the act is resisting police, causing injury. In Chinese criminal law, assault on police is "妨害公务" (obstructing official duties) which includes assaulting police. The list includes "妨害公务". Also "故意伤害" is separate but the facts show he caused injury to police. The typical charge for assaulting police is "妨害公务". In examples earlier, they used "妨害公务" for cases where someone attacked police (e.g., the case with dangerous driving and biting police). So we should label "妨害公务". Any other charge? Possibly "故意毁坏财物" for tearing up the statement? That's destroying a police document. But the main charge is obstruction of public duties. The list includes "故意毁坏财物". However, tearing up a police record could be considered "故意毁坏公文" but not in list. The list includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". Not applicable. So likely only "妨害公务". Also maybe "故意伤害" because he caused injury to police. In earlier example with dangerous driving and biting police, they gave both "危险驾驶;妨害公务". They didn't include "故意伤害". So they treat assault on police as "妨害公务". So answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>
